landing.faq.title: FAQ
landing.faq.a1: A platform for CTF competitions and cybersecurity practice: flag-checked challenges, isolated labs and a live scoreboard in one place. Created at Kharkiv National University of Radio Electronics (KhNURE), in the V. V. Popovskyi ICE Department.
landing.faq.a2: For participants — university students, school students who compete in olympiads, and teams from other institutions — and for organizers who run competitions and olympiads.
landing.faq.q3: Can I play solo, or only in a team?
landing.faq.a3: Both. The organizer picks an individual or a team format; in a team event you create a team or join one with a code.
landing.faq.q4: What kinds of challenges are there?
landing.faq.a4: Web, cryptography, binary exploitation, reverse engineering, forensics. Simple challenges are verified with a flag; more complex ones deploy their own infrastructure.

landing.faq.a5: Every challenge with infrastructure gets its own isolated network. Connect with a one-click WireGuard profile or through the web proxy right in the browser.
landing.faq.a6: Points can be dynamic: the more participants solve a challenge, the fewer points it is worth. The scoreboard updates live, and there is a separate projector screen for the venue.

landing.faq.a7: Flags are checked on the server and labs are isolated from each other. The organizer sees every attempt and can annul a solve.
landing.faq.q8: How do I run my own event?
landing.faq.a8: Organizers set up the event themselves: format, registration, challenges from the catalog, pages and the live screen. Organizer access comes from the platform team.
landing.faq.q9: What does it cost and how do I start?
landing.faq.a9: Taking part is free. Start with the warm-up on this page, then register for an event via the organizer's link.

legal.terms.title: Terms of Use
legal.terms.intro: These Terms govern access to and use of the Cyber ICE Box platform (the "Platform"), an environment for cybersecurity training labs and CTF competitions. By registering, you agree to these Terms.
legal.terms.s1.heading: Acceptance of terms
legal.terms.s1.body: By creating an account or taking part in events, you confirm that you have read and agree to comply with these Terms and the Privacy Policy.
legal.terms.s2.heading: Acceptable use of labs
legal.terms.s2.body: All vulnerable targets and infrastructure are provided solely for educational purposes within isolated labs. You must not use the techniques or tools obtained here against systems outside the provided environment without the written permission of their owners.
legal.terms.s3.heading: Fair play in competitions
legal.terms.s3.body: The following are prohibited: sharing flags or solutions during an active event; attacking the infrastructure of the Platform or other participants; using multiple accounts to inflate scores. Violations result in disqualification.
legal.terms.s4.heading: Accounts and teams
legal.terms.s4.body: You are responsible for safeguarding access to your account. Teams are formed by participants; organizers may set team size limits for specific events.
legal.terms.s5.heading: Intellectual property
legal.terms.s5.body: Challenges, lab scenarios and other Platform materials are the property of Cyber ICE Box and its partners. Distributing challenge descriptions outside the Platform without permission is prohibited.
legal.terms.s6.heading: Changes and termination
legal.terms.s6.body: We may update these Terms and suspend access in the event of a breach. Material changes will be announced on the Platform or by email.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: This Policy explains what data the Cyber ICE Box platform (the "Platform") processes, for what purposes, and how we protect it. We process only the minimum data necessary to operate training labs and competitions.
legal.privacy.s1.heading: Data we process
legal.privacy.s1.body: Account data: name, email address and, optionally, a Google account identifier. Activity data: event participation, submitted solutions, scores and team membership. Technical data: access logs for labs and VPN sessions, used to ensure security.
legal.privacy.s2.heading: Purpose of processing
legal.privacy.s2.body: Data is used for authentication, providing access to isolated environments, maintaining rankings and preventing abuse. We do not sell personal data to third parties.
legal.privacy.s3.heading: Sign-in with Google
legal.privacy.s3.body: If you sign in with Google, we receive only your basic profile (name and email address) in order to create your account. The Platform has no access to your Google password.
legal.privacy.s4.heading: Sessions and cookies
legal.privacy.s4.body: We use strictly necessary cookies to maintain your sign-in session. We do not use third-party analytics or advertising trackers.
legal.privacy.s5.heading: Retention and deletion
legal.privacy.s5.body: Account data is retained for as long as the account remains active. You may request deletion of your account; your personal data will then be deleted, except for anonymized records required to preserve the integrity of competition results.
legal.privacy.s6.heading: Security
legal.privacy.s6.body: Access to labs is isolated at network level; training targets contain no real personal data. Data in transit is encrypted (TLS, WireGuard).
legal.privacy.s7.heading: Your rights
legal.privacy.s7.body: You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, and to obtain a copy of it. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.
consent.title: Analytics cookies
consent.text: We would like to use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use the platform. Analytics cookies are set only with your consent; declining does not limit any features. See the {link} for details.
